bounded_context: Existing public operation and lifecycle composition test consumers
method: Use existing qualified real-Git fixture constructors and regression functions. First prove the original regression, then replace one actual trusted canonical function guard in memory and require that same regression to observe the named fault. No synthetic source inventory, foreign evaluator or candidate code execution.

controls.expected_detector: existing unrelated-function negative raises pytest Failed DID NOT RAISE when guard is removed

controls.cause: committed source replaced by working-tree reads
controls.expected_detector: existing successful captured-source regression now raises typed public source-conformance error after postcapture substitution
existing early-catalog regression raises its exact full-source-discovered-before-rejection failure

invariants: Four exact detector cases, separate baseline and mutant real-Git roots and restored module bindings.
Require the precise behavioral/domain failure; collection, setup, mutation-target mismatch and unrelated exceptions cannot qualify a detector.
Run through the existing canonical test gate and JUnit family; no new registry, receipt family, evaluator, broker or source-policy ownership.
Production source and all existing gate-control descriptors remain unchanged; current registry capacity and source limits retained.
Passing these test-scoped fault controls does not grant BCF receipt, phase, installed parity, runtime completeness or release authority.
